subject.title: [Feature]: Per-user heartbeat routing for channel-level heartbeat messages

question: Should OpenClaw add a WhatsApp/channel heartbeat recipient config for OK-only admin acknowledgments, and if so should the permanent contract be `target`, `targets`, or a broader recipient object?
rationale: This adds a user-facing config surface in a compatibility-sensitive channel routing path, and repository policy sets a high bar for new config knobs without maintainer product direction.

options.title: Add OK-only heartbeat recipients
options.body: Define an additive, validated recipient contract in the channel heartbeat config and keep omitted config fully backward-compatible.

options.title: Use existing agent heartbeat target/to
options.body: Reject a new channel config knob and document that operators should route the whole heartbeat to an admin target instead, accepting that alert routing changes with it.

options.title: Defer to a broader routing design
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers design a shared channel heartbeat routing model across WhatsApp and other messaging plugins.

recommendation.title: Add OK-only heartbeat recipients
recommendation.body: Define an additive, validated recipient contract in the channel heartbeat config and keep omitted config fully backward-compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across heartbeat delivery, outbound routing, and the existing review comment for this item.
